inputs.style: Entirely instrumental long-session historical strategy map background music, no human voice, no speech, no lyrics, no choir, no chanting or humming. 80 BPM, 4/4, D minor with gentle F major colors. Sparse guzheng ostinato, soft pipa, breathy bamboo flute, warm string chamber ensemble, occasional low clarinet and restrained horn. Share an original D F G A C motif with the main menu theme. Calm deliberate exploration, river valleys and rail supply planning, early twentieth century Chinese setting; thoughtful diplomacy with mild undercurrents of uncertainty. Eight-bar introduction, sixteen-bar exploration, twelve-bar development, eight-bar restrained tension, twelve-bar return, four-bar settled cadence. Stable moderate dynamics, no sudden loud impacts, no foley, no synth arpeggios or electronic beat. Warm natural room, orchestration leaves space for interface and battlefield cues.
